The structure of composition Cu8Ge4Au4 (reduced formula Cu2GeAu) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies body-centered-cubic-like local arrangements for all three elements: each Au and Ge center has 8 Cu neighbors, while each Cu center has 4 Au and 4 Ge neighbors, all at 2.5951 Å. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component containing all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Cu–Cu polyhedra with corner, edge, and face contacts, and Au–Ge polyhedra with corner and face contacts.
